note: Cs: curated NIST fit exclusions only (no literature rows yet). Rows citing 'PUBLISHED' are transcribed published matrix elements (f_values/<El>_published_anchors.json); rows citing 'ARC' are the ARC model potential scaled to them. Both are used only where NIST lists no f. Known gap: Cs 6s->np1/2 for n>=26 is left dropped (Cooper-minimum suppression; the channel is 0.12 % of the 14p1/2 decay and 0.02 % of 20p1/2, so the omission changes no lifetime by more than ~0.02 %); the ARC model potential overestimates this series by 1-3 orders of magnitude and no published values exist beyond n=12 (PRA 107, 042809).

nist_fit_exclusions.ref: NIST 6s->np1/2 f jumps by x90 between n=21 (1.7e-8) and n=22 (1.5e-6), values for n>=22 follow the 3/2 series and not the Cooper-minimum series n<=21; points left out of the extrapolation fit only

generated_with.note: rows whose ref starts with "ARC " or "PUBLISHED" are regenerated by the tool; all other rows, the note, caveats and fit exclusions are never modified by it
